_meta.purpose: Illustrative neighbourhood topology, charging candidates and planning assumptions.

neighbourhood_name.assumption: assumption: illustrative neighbourhood label; not an actual surveyed network

transformers.assumption: assumption: illustrative transformer locations, customer counts and archetypes; each is 250 kVA and shares config/transformer.json; not surveyed data

sites.unit: site objects; power kW; x/y map units
sites.assumption: assumption: illustrative charging candidates, ratings, footfall scores and locations; not measured data

target_kw_options.assumption: assumption: illustrative planning targets; editable planning input

target_kw_default.assumption: assumption: illustrative default planning target; editable planning input

allocation_block_kw.assumption: assumption: illustrative discrete allocation block; editable planning input

hosting_search_max_kw.assumption: assumption: illustrative bounded hosting search ceiling; editable planning input

month_weekday_count.assumption: assumption: illustrative peak summer month weekdays; editable planning input

month_weekend_count.assumption: assumption: illustrative peak summer month weekends using summer weather; editable planning input

nominal_home_voltage_v.assumption: assumption: illustrative nominal household supply voltage; editable planning input

managed_cap_fractions.assumption: assumption: illustrative managed charging candidate caps; editable planning input

managed_offpeak_start_hour.assumption: assumption: illustrative overnight redistribution start; editable planning input

managed_offpeak_end_hour.assumption: assumption: illustrative overnight redistribution end; editable planning input

min_served_energy_pct_for_managed.assumption: assumption: illustrative minimum energy retained by managed charging; editable planning input

managed_charging_cost_per_site_inr.assumption: assumption: illustrative placeholder for a smart-charging controller and communications per site; replace with a quote
